name: Keybloom
author: schmittcn
description: Your Keychron's lighting from the bar: follow the Omarchy theme, run a rainbow, pulse with your music, or pick effect, color, speed and brightness yourself; cycle effects with a key and go dark when idle. Changes stay in the keyboard's RAM, so its flash is only written when you ask.

barWidget.description: Keychron lighting: theme sync, effects, colors, music, idle off.
